shellCommandPrefix:
export MSYSTEM=MINGW64
export QMK_DISTRIB_DIR="${QMK_DISTRIB_DIR:-/opt/qmk}"
export PATH="$QMK_DISTRIB_DIR/bin:/opt/uv/tools/bin:/mingw64/bin:/usr/bin:$PATH"
export USERPROFILE="$(cygpath -w "$HOME")"
export HOMEDRIVE="${USERPROFILE%%:*}:"
export HOMEPATH="${USERPROFILE#*:}"
export QMK_HOME="${QMK_HOME:-$(cygpath -u "$HOME")/qmk_firmware}"
export SHELL="$(cygpath -m /usr/bin/bash.exe)"
